request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment, with monthly reporting; other final delivery deadline not stated in document.
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with safety mechanisms and reserve-ratio rules
Composable FIRE and ICE Cardano-native assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Public dashboards showing reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, and launch-readiness review
Ecosystem education, DRep communications, partner activation, and launch coordination
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for a planning budget of about USD 2.0 million split between launch liquidity/infrastructure and delivery/audit/integrations/go-to-market.

Pool 1 is approximately USD 1.0 million for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, deployed in three monthly tranches of approximately USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000 after specified reviews and performance checks.

Pool 2 is approximately USD 1.0 million for delivery, audit, integrations, and go-to-market, with itemized planning allocations including USD 250,000 for protocol infrastructure, USD 300,000 for engineering and delivery support, and USD 200,000 for security review, audit, and economic modeling.
Alchemy will use a shared BTC reserve architecture where FIRE and ICE are backed by the same BTC reserve, with reserve ratio and FIRE pricing formulas stated in the proposal.

The system targets an initial 5.0x reserve ratio and uses safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x to constrain minting, redemption, and risky activity as reserve conditions change.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-backed claim with upside and first-loss downside, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset with growth potential.

The proposal states that launch liquidity will be treasury-supported and treasury-owned, and that profits, yield, and returns generated by the launch liquidity position will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly.

The principal can be returned to the Treasury after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a formal governance proposal for DRep and Constitutional Committee review.

The proposal identifies BTC volatility, oracle risk, bridge risk, Charms protocol-layer risk, novel asset risk, delivery risk, and adoption risk, and proposes mitigations including overcollateralization, audits, economic modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, legal/compliance work, reporting, and administrator oversight.
The proposal cites external references for the Alchemy simulator, Strategy Q1 2026 results, a Cardano Constitution update, and a 2026-2027 NCL reference.

summary: The document presents a 10,000,000 ada treasury request for a BTCfi infrastructure protocol with a two-pool budget, staged liquidity deployment, FIRE/ICE asset mechanics, reserve safety rules, reporting, audit, governance controls, and stated treasury-return mechanisms.
